title: Clothing store in Philadelphia (no construction)
assumptions: The company already exists (Fishtown Apparel LLC). Hires staff. Moves into a space that needs no construction. Puts up an exterior sign.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: PA Online Business Tax Registration (sales tax license; employer withholding and UC)
items.agency: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue (myPATH), with L&I for UC
items.note: UC registration is filed through myPATH within 30 days after covered services begin.

items.name: Philadelphia tax account (BIRT)
items.agency: City of Philadelphia Department of Revenue

items.name: Commercial Activity License
items.agency: City of Philadelphia, Department of Licenses and Inspections

items.name: Zoning approval (proof of occupancy)
items.agency: City of Philadelphia, Department of Licenses and Inspections
items.condition: Unless a license for the same space and business type was issued within 3 years.

items.name: Workers' compensation insurance
items.agency: Pennsylvania Department of Labor and Industry, Bureau of Workers' Compensation
items.note: Added in the coverage audit of 2026-10-22: bought from an insurer once there is staff.

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
mustNotInclude.why: A store that sells no food needs no food permit.
